    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

path_sphere1 = chrono.ChBodyEasySphere(1.0)
path_sphere1.SetPos(path_center + chrono.ChVector3d(path_radius, 0, 0))
path_sphere1.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(1, 0, 0))  # Red
vehicle.GetSystem().Add(path_sphere1)

path_sphere2 = chrono.ChBodyEasySphere(1.0)
path_sphere2.SetPos(path_center + chrono.ChVector3d(-path_radius, 0, 0))
path_sphere2.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0, 1, 0))  # Green
vehicle.GetSystem().Add(path_sphere2)

# Initialize simulation frame counter s
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

# Simulation loop
while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0):
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs (constant throttle)
    throttle = 0.3
    steering_angle = 0.0  # Initialize steering angle

    # PID control for steering
    target_pos = path_center + chrono.ChVector3d(path_radius * math.cos(time), path_radius * math.sin(time), 0)
    error = target_pos - vehicle.GetChassis().GetPos()
    derivative = (error - prev_error) / step_size
    integral += error * step_size
    steering_angle = kp * error + ki * integral + kd * derivative

    prev_error = error

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, throttle, steering_angle, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, throttle, steering_angle)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
